hooks.command: $f = Join-Path "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" '.claude/hooks/compact-handoff.ps1'; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($r) { $f = Join-Path $r '.claude/hooks/compact-handoff.ps1' } }; if (Test-Path $f) { & $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

$f = Join-Path "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" '.claude/hooks/machine-guard.ps1'; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($r) { $f = Join-Path $r '.claude/hooks/machine-guard.ps1' } }; if (Test-Path $f) { & $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

$f = Join-Path "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" '.claude/hooks/build-check.ps1'; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $r = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($r) { $f = Join-Path $r '.claude/hooks/build-check.ps1' } }; if (Test-Path $f) { & $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
